transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?
I guess… mostly I’m here because I’ve been really tired. Not the usual kind. I can sleep and still get through work, but I feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even really starts.
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep during the night?

I fall asleep okay most nights. It’s more that I wake up early… around four, usually. Then my head’s already on work stuff—servers, deadlines—and I just lie there until the alarm. Feels like I didn’t really get a full night.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah… I suppose so. For a long time now things have just felt kind of gray. Fishing, working in the tomatoes, even a church concert… I’ll still do them sometimes, but it feels more like checking something off than actually enjoying it.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or like you’re not good enough lately?
I don’t know… not especially. I mean, I can be hard on myself when work doesn’t go right, but I wouldn’t say guilt is the main thing.
Would you say that you feel down or depressed most days, even when there’s no specific reason for it?

Yeah… I’d say most days there’s just this flat, gray feeling. Not always tied to anything in particular. Even things I used to look forward to—fishing, the tomatoes, a church concert—just feel more like things to get through.
Do you find that even after a full night’s sleep, you still feel physically heavy or exhausted throughout the day?

Yeah… that’s actually a lot of why I came in. I can sleep okay, and I’m still getting through work, but I wake up feeling like I’m already running on low battery. Kind of heavy before the day even starts.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?
I don’t think so. I mean, maybe I drag a little when I’m tired, but I haven’t really noticed moving slow or feeling like I can’t sit still.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the fatigue and the gray mood most days?
About… two years and a few months, I guess. Since I got pulled back into running operations day-to-day. Maybe two years and four months.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living or had thoughts of harming yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve felt worn down, but I haven’t had thoughts of hurting myself.
Have you noticed a significant loss of energy or feel that even small tasks take a lot of effort lately?

Yeah… that’s mostly why I came in. I’m tired in a way that doesn’t really add up. I can sleep and still keep up with work, but I feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even gets started.
Have you found yourself sleeping more than usual, or needing more sleep to feel rested?

Not more sleep, exactly. I usually fall asleep okay… but I wake up around four, and my head’s already on server problems or compliance deadlines. Then I’m just lying there until the alarm, and it feels like the night didn’t really count.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, focus, or make decisions lately?
I’m not sure. I mean… I can still make decisions when I need to. I haven’t noticed anything major there. Maybe I’m a little slower some days, but nothing I’d call a big change.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to care about, like fishing or working in the tomatoes, and don’t even want to do them anymore?

Completely lost interest… no, I wouldn’t say completely. I still do them sometimes. But for a long while now, most days things just feel kind of gray. Fishing, the tomatoes, even a church concert… they feel more like something I’m supposed to do than something I’m really looking forward to.
Have you ever felt like you need to sleep all the time or that you could sleep for many hours and still feel tired?

Yeah… kind of. Not like I’m sleeping all day, but I’m tired in a way that doesn’t add up. I can sleep and still get through work, but I feel like I’m on a low battery before the day even really starts.
Have you ever felt like you could sleep for many hours and still not feel rested, even if you’re not getting up early?
Yeah… that’s pretty much it. I can sleep enough, and I’m not necessarily up that early, but I still don’t feel rested. It’s like I’m starting the day already drained.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite—like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?

Yeah… somewhat. I don’t really notice it in the moment, but I’ll skip lunch or just work through it, then not eat much at dinner. My wife’s mentioned my pants are fitting looser, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
Would you say that your mood is consistently low, even when things are going well in your life?

Yeah… I’d say so. Even when nothing’s really wrong, it’s like there’s this gray, flat feeling most days. Things I used to look forward to—fishing, the tomatoes, a church concert—just feel more like things to get through than enjoy.
Have you noticed that it's harder to focus or think clearly, even when you're not tired?
I don’t know… not really in a way I’ve paid attention to. I have moments where I’m slower getting going, but I can’t say it’s a clear focus problem.
Would you say that you get less pleasure out of things now than you used to, like fishing or working in the tomatoes?
Yeah… I guess I do. Fishing, the tomatoes, even a church concert… they don’t really feel enjoyable like they used to. More like things I’m supposed to do, or get through. Kind of flat, most days.
